title: A root may list its own placeholder names in _root.md while the leak shapes stay the same for every root
goal: _root.md may carry placeholders: a short list of extra example names (a root's own fictitious host, user and device names) that redact and the leak scan treat as placeholders for that root's files only. The set of leak shapes, the shipped placeholders and the scan of every other root, the tools and the docs are unchanged; a root's extra name that matches a leak shape other than as an exact placeholder is refused when the root loads.

gates.question: Is a per-root placeholder set worth building, given the shipped placeholders cover the shapes and the scan guards what may be published?
options: Build it after the redaction stories in flight land
Leave it out until a root has a concrete name that is wrongly rewritten
gates.recommendation: Leave it out until a root has a concrete name that is wrongly rewritten
gates.reason: because it widens a guard that is being hardened right now, and the cost of using the shipped placeholders is low
gates.answer: Build it after the redaction stories in flight land

gates.question: If it is built, what may a root's extra placeholder be?
options: A user name only, and only for logon and profile-path shapes, listed in _root.md and checked at load against every shape
gates.recommendation: A user name only, and only for logon and profile-path shapes, listed in _root.md and checked at load against every shape
gates.reason: because the premise shows no other shape needs it and a narrow list cannot open a hole for the other shapes
gates.answer: A user name only, and only for logon and profile-path shapes, listed in _root.md and checked at load against every shape

notes:
Premise (plan time, synthetic names): redact.redact rewrites a logon shape with a fictitious user other than the shipped placeholder, and a profile path with such a user; kbcommon.leak_hits flags the same profile path as a home folder. It does not reproduce for a device name like PL-LT-00999, a bare user name or an email on corp.example.com, so the need is logon and profile-path shapes only. PLACEHOLDERS is one dict in redact.py; the scan of every tracked file must still pass with no root setting anything.
Operator: g1 build after the redaction stories in flight land (ST-xllrtqlt, after ST-yl6b2ues); g2 user names only. Order: after ST-3j3wlgg4 (test_redact.py).
Checks 0, 1 and 2 (the redact and leak tests, perfcheck ids) pass before the work and pin behaviour that must stay unchanged (the leak shapes, the shipped placeholders, the test ids); checks 3 and 4 fail before it with a one-line reason.
Contract: Root.placeholders is a tuple; kbcommon.leak_hits(text, allow=None, root=None) and redact.redact(text, root=None) let a root's own placeholders pass for its files only; fixtures _tools/fixtures/placeholders/{ok (placeholders: anna.nowak), bad (one that matches a leak shape; the refusal names `placeholders` in backticks)}.
